review:
Elemental magic with tumbles and wild-making features. A fiery wild can land on any spin, and the Lightning Bolt replaces random symbols with extra wilds.

Four or more scatters trigger free spins – with an option to gamble for more. Every tumble in the bonus adds 1x to a multiplier that never resets, so a long bonus can build something huge. Up to 40,000x, 96.08% RTP. Try the gamble in demo first – it can cost you the spins you've got.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo

Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
